name: generator-check-diagnostics
cmd: bun -e 'import{readFileSync}from"node:fs";import{gunzipSync}from"node:zlib";for(const file of ["source/generator-source-checks.log","tooling/generator-tooling-check.log"]){const text=readFileSync(file,"utf8");for(const line of text.split("\n")){if(!line.startsWith("GENERATOR_CHECK "))continue;const r=JSON.parse(line.slice("GENERATOR_CHECK ".length)),raw=gunzipSync(Buffer.from(r.traceGzipBase64,"base64")).toString();console.log("GENERATOR_CHECK_DIAG "+JSON.stringify({file,label:r.label,exit:r.exit,wallMs:r.wallMs,detail:r.exit===0?raw.split("\n").filter(l=>/pass|fail|expect\(|warnings|errors|Finished in/.test(l)).slice(-8):raw.slice(-16000)}))}}'
